30 minutes • Admission Ticket Free

Arizona's Joshua Tree Forest (Pass By)

Travel through the ancient Joshua Tree Forest en route to the West Rim of the Grand Canyon.

Grand Canyon West

The West Rim is the western end of the Colorado Canyon. It is a protected area of the Hualapai Indian Tribe. It is developed by investors and is not managed by the Grand Canyon National Park. It is within three hours one-way from Las Vegas. A U-shaped glass corridor, known as Skywalk was also built here for everyone to feel the height and excitement of the canyon. (Total time spend at West Rim are 3.5 hours, including selected options)

3 hours 30 minutes • Admission Ticket Included

Eagle Point

Make your way to Eagle Point, home of the Grand Canyon Skywalk. This viewing point gives you spectacular views of the West Rim of the Grand Canyon. Spot the eagle in the rocks which gave this lookout its name!

• Admission Ticket Included

Grand Canyon Skywalk

Unparalleled views of one of the world’s Seven Natural Wonders await you at Grand Canyon West on Skywalk. This breathtaking 10-foot wide, horseshoe-shaped glass bridge extends 70 feet out over the rim of the Grand Canyon, giving you a clear view 4,000 feet to the Canyon floor below. There’s simply no thrill like stepping out on glass thousands of feet in the air. (Total time spend at West Rim are 3.5 hours, optional for Skywalk and Helicopter Tour, additional admission fees apply, need to purchase tickets from the tour guide).

• Admission Ticket MAY NOT included based on which option selected

Guano Point

Even more spectacular views can be enjoyed at Guano Point over the Colorado River! You may take a hike here to the highest point where the scenic vantage offers a majestic view of the Colorado River or just simply relax and enjoy the peacefulness of Grand Canyon West whilst.

• Admission Ticket Included

Hoover Dam--Mike O'Callaghan–Pat Tillman Memorial Bridge

Mike O'Callaghan–Pat Tillman Memorial Bridge for a photo stop of Hoover Dam
